title: Group Fitness Class Passes: a class may be booked only while the pack is active
content:
## Scope
This document states the Group Fitness Class Passes basis for when a class booking, including a booking made by promotion from a waitlist, may be made against a class-credit pack, across every tier of the product.

## Basis
A class may be booked, whether directly or through promotion from the waitlist into an open spot, only while the pack being booked against is in active status on the system's own record. The pack's current status, as held in the system record for that specific pack, is the sole basis for this judgement; a pack that has not yet been activated, or that has already become exhausted, expired or closed, does not satisfy this basis.

## Points of judgement
- The evidentiary basis is the pack's own status field on the system record correlated to the specific pack being booked against, not any other record and not the member's own statement of the pack's condition.
- A pack in applied status (payment not yet captured) does not qualify, and neither does a pack already exhausted, expired or closed; only active status qualifies.
